note: Daily origins inside each block; cells from neighbouring origins overlap, so every interval is a block bootstrap over origins, never over cells. Blocks were fixed before any comparative result was inspected.

development.use: hypothesis exploration; the improver may read errors here

checkpoint.use: acceptance test for a candidate F_{g+1} and for I_1; the improver never reads per-cell errors here before proposing

protected.use: scored once per final lineage member and for the common-start improver comparison; last origin whose 7-day target is inside the pack

official.use: submission; scored by the organisers on 2026-11-15
